verdict.rationale: The IRS is the US federal tax authority, not a commercial data host. Taxpayer records are inherently held by that sovereign agency, so letting a user pick a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack suggests otherwise: the items cover EIN, e-file, IRIS, ID.me sign-in and payment rails, and none mention storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
